source_text: De ecclesia: vulpes = perversi doctores haereticorum; doctores ecclesiae potestatem capiendi accipiunt sicut calcandi serpentes. Pusillae vineae = animae rudes scandalizabiles; perfectae pax multa sine scandalo.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning church: foxes = perverse teachers of-heretics; teachers of-church power of-catching receive as of-trampling serpents. Little vineyards = souls raw scandalizable; perfect-ones peace much without scandal.
pass_b_english: Of the church: foxes are perverse teachers of heresies; teachers of the church receive power to catch them as to [[tread on serpents >> Bible:Luke 10:19]]. Little vineyards are unformed souls open to scandal; the perfect have [[much peace and no scandal >> Bible:Psalm 119:165]].
